fields.description: Bit-packed career/boxer record region (248 bytes). Read by FUN_0801bd90 from EEPROM address 0x1F into RAM and bit-unpacked field-by-field by FUN_0801820c (6-/5-/4-/2-bit groups). Fully erased (0xFF) in baseline: no career progress saved yet.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801bd90 reads 0xF8 bytes from EEPROM address 0x1F (file bytes 248..495) via FUN_0801ba80; caller FUN_08019678 passes the buffer to FUN_0801820c which bit-unpacks boxer records.
fields.name: career_data_packed

fields.description: Config payload word 3 (buffer word 4). Stored from DAT_0801bc48[2] by FUN_0801bc0c and restored into DAT_0801bcdc[2] by FUN_0801bc58. Erased (0xFFFF) in baseline.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801bc58 loads 16-byte block via FUN_0801ba80(0,buf,0x3e,0x10); payload word maps to DAT_0801bc48[2]/DAT_0801bcdc[2]; defaults written by FUN_0801bc0c.
fields.name: config_word_3

fields.description: Additive checksum word (buffer word 6): FUN_0801ba80 write path stores -(sum of buffer words 0..5); read path requires sum of buffer words 0..6 == 0 mod 0x10000. Custom algorithm with non-contiguous file coverage (blocks stored swapped), so represented as a plain u16_le field; see SPEC.md. Verifies 0xABB5 against baseline in the rev8 logical domain.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801ba80 write path sets buf[u16count-2] = -sum(buf words); read path returns 0x1000 unless sum == 0. Baseline: 0x0000+0x0001+0xFFFF*3+0x544D+0xABB5 == 0x10000.
fields.name: config_checksum

fields.description: Write-counter mirror (buffer word 7). Must equal config_save_counter; FUN_0801ba80 read path rejects the block (0x1000) on mismatch.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801ba80 read path requires *buf == buf[wordcount-1]; write path sets both to previous counter + 1. Baseline 0x0000 == counter.
fields.name: config_save_counter_mirror

fields.description: Config-block write counter (buffer word 0). Incremented on every save by the FUN_0801ba80 write path; must equal the mirror word or the block is rejected.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801ba80 write path (param_1 != 0) sets buf[0] = buf[wordcount-1] = old counter + 1 via FUN_0801c3d4/FUN_0801c484; read path requires equality. Baseline 0x0000.
fields.name: config_save_counter

flag_labels.9: init-select flag (tested as bit 0x200 in FUN_0801bc0c)

fields.description: Config payload word 0 (buffer word 1). Mirrors *DAT_0801bc44 into the save and restores it into *DAT_0801bcd8 on load; bit 9 (0x200) selects the init path in FUN_0801bc0c. Baseline 0x0001.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801bc58 loads it as local_12 from FUN_0801ba80(0,buf,0x3e,0x10) buffer and stores to *DAT_0801bcd8; FUN_0801bc0c sources defaults from *DAT_0801bc44 and tests bit 0x200.
fields.name: config_word_0

fields.description: Config payload word 1 (buffer word 2). Stored from DAT_0801bc48[0] by FUN_0801bc0c and restored into DAT_0801bcdc[0] by FUN_0801bc58. Erased (0xFFFF) in baseline.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801bc58 loads 16-byte block via FUN_0801ba80(0,buf,0x3e,0x10); payload word maps to DAT_0801bc48[0]/DAT_0801bcdc[0]; defaults written by FUN_0801bc0c.
fields.name: config_word_1

fields.description: Config payload word 2 (buffer word 3). Stored from DAT_0801bc48[1] by FUN_0801bc0c and restored into DAT_0801bcdc[1] by FUN_0801bc58. Erased (0xFFFF) in baseline.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801bc58 loads 16-byte block via FUN_0801ba80(0,buf,0x3e,0x10); payload word maps to DAT_0801bc48[1]/DAT_0801bcdc[1]; defaults written by FUN_0801bc0c.

magic_signatures.description: ASCII 'MT' config-block tag (buffer word 5). FUN_0801bc58 compares it against ROM constant DAT_0801bca4 and re-initializes defaults on mismatch.
